title: ReasonEdit: Editing Vision-Language Models using Human Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2602.02408v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model editing aims to correct errors in large, pretrained models without altering unrelated behaviors. While some recent works have edited vision-language models (VLMs), no existing editors tackle reasoning-heavy tasks, which typically require humans and models to reason about images. We therefore propose ReasonEdit, the first VLM editor to let users explain their reasoning during editing, introducing a new, practical model editing setup. ReasonEdit continuously stores human reasoning in a codebook, and retrieves only relevant facts during inference using a novel topology-balanced multimodal embedding method inspired by network science. Across four VLMs on multiple rationale-based visual question answering datasets, ReasonEdit achieves state-of-the-art editing performance, ultimately showing that using human reasoning during editing greatly improves edit generalization.

translated_title: ReasonEdit：利用人类推理编辑视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 模型编辑旨在纠正大型预训练模型中的错误，而不改变无关行为。虽然近期一些工作已对视觉语言模型（VLM）进行了编辑，但现有编辑器均未处理推理密集型任务，这类任务通常需要人类和模型对图像进行推理。因此，我们提出ReasonEdit，这是首个让用户在编辑过程中解释其推理的VLM编辑器，引入了一种新颖且实用的模型编辑设置。ReasonEdit将人类推理持续存储在一个码本中，并在推理期间通过一种受网络科学启发的拓扑平衡多模态嵌入方法，仅检索相关事实。在多个基于推理的视觉问答数据集上，跨四个VLM，ReasonEdit实现了最先进的编辑性能，最终表明在编辑过程中使用人类推理能大幅提升编辑泛化能力。
tldr: 本文提出ReasonEdit，首个允许用户编辑时提供推理解释的视觉语言模型编辑器，通过码本存储和拓扑平衡嵌入检索，显著提升编辑泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ReasonEdit, the first VLM editor that allows users to provide reasoning during editing, using a codebook and topology-balanced embedding retrieval to greatly improve edit generalization.
